text: The Isle of Man (Manx: Ellan Vannin) is an island in the Irish Sea, off the coast of Great Britain (of which it is a crown dependency). Douglas is the capital city. It also has a flag with a red background and 3 armoured legs joined together - "whichever way you throw us, we always land on our feet". It has a Parliament called Tynwald which is over 1,000 years old. This makes it the longest running parliament in the world.
title: Isle of Man

text: James Todd Smith (born January 14, 1968) is an American rapper, songwriter, record producer and actor. He is known professionally as LL Cool J (Ladies Love Cool James). He currently stars on the CBS crime drama television series NCIS: Los Angeles as Special Agent Sam Hanna. As a rapper, he has released thirteen studio albums. Some of his most well known songs are "Mama Said Knock You Out", "I'm Bad", "Rock the Bells", "I Can't Live Without My Radio", "Hey Lover", "Loungin", "4,3,2,1", "Luv U Better", "The Boomin' System" and "Murdergram Deux". His last album Authentic was released on April 30, 2013. Cool J is married to his wife Simone and is a Christian.
title: LL Cool J

text: Hugo Arana (July 23, 1943 – October 11, 2020) was an Argentine actor and comedian. He was born in Monte Grande, Argentina. His career began in 1970. His best known roles were in El Santo de la Espada, The Truce and Los exitosos Pells. Arana died at a Buenos Aires hospital from COVID-19 on October 11, 2020 at the age of 77.
title: Hugo Arana

text: Nicolas Chumachenco (also known as Nicolas Chumachenko; March 27, 1944 – December 12, 2020), was a Polish-born Spanish-German violin soloist and professor. He was director of the Queen Sofía Chamber Orchestra. Chumachenco was born in Kraków, in Nazi-occupied Poland, to Ukrainian parents who left Poland at the end of the Second World War. Chumachenco died on December 12, 2020 in Schallstadt, Germany at the age of 76.
title: Nicolas Chumachenco

text: Johnny's Greatest Hits is a greatest hits album by Johnny Mathis. It was released on 17 March 1958 through Columbia Records and went to number 1 for three weeks in the United States and spent a then record 490 weeks in the countdown.
title: Johnny's Greatest Hits

text: The Iraqi–Kurdish conflict is an ongoing armed conflict between Iraq and the Kurdish people, it began in the 20th century immediately after the Ottoman Empire lost the First World War until the US invasion of Iraq in 2003, though smaller clashes are still occurring. Some pointed that Mahmud Barzanji's efforts to create an independent Kurdish kingdom as the start of the conflict but others think that it was in 1961 with a revolt by Barzanis.
title: Iraqi–Kurdish conflict
